actions.name: invoke_custom_js_code
actions.title: Execute code
actions.help: Execute custom JavaScript code in the recipe. Write your code within the exports.main block. Standard JavaScript libraries available in NodeJS are included. This action will timeout after 30 seconds.

input.name: name
input.label: Name
input.hint: What does this step do? E.g.: Get account details/Transform customer data etc.

input.name: code_input
input.label: Input fields
input.hint: Define the input fields that will be passed to your JavaScript code

input.name: code_output_schema_json
input.label: Output fields
input.hint: Learn how to configure output for this action here .

input.name: payload_asset_type
input.label: JavaScript snippet source
input.hint: • Define manually — Write the JavaScript snippet directly in this action. • Use a resource — Reference a snippet file managed in your Workato project.

input.name: snippet_document_static_asset
input.label: JavaScript Snippet Resource
input.hint: Select a JavaScript snippet resource to be used for executing the code.

input.name: code
input.label: Code
